dialogue.origin: （こんばんは。本日は宜しくお願いします！お時間になりましたら、始めさせて頂きます。）
dialogue.content: (Good evening. Thank you for being here today! We will begin at the scheduled time.)

dialogue.origin: こんばんは！家事をしており、お返事がギリギリになってしまい申し訳ありません。こちらこそよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Good evening! I was doing some housework, so I apologize for the last-minute reply. I'm looking forward to our session as well.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ。大丈夫です＾＾よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Not at all. It's perfectly fine. :) I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.origin: 本日はご相談にお越しいただき、ありがとうございます。よろしければ、あなたの年齢、性別をお聞かせ頂けますか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming for a consultation today. If you're comfortable with it, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 35歳女です。
dialogue.content: I'm a 35-year-old woman.

dialogue.origin: お答えいただき、ありがとうございます。本日は、どのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 中学生の娘がいるのですが、手伝いをしてくれません。私はシングルマザーで結構てんてこまいで家事などしてます。仕事から帰ったらクタクタなんですが話しても聞き流されます。どうすれば手伝ってくれるかなあと悩んでいます。
dialogue.content: I have a daughter in junior high, but she doesn't help out. I'm a single mother and I'm pretty swamped with housework. I'm exhausted when I get home from work, but even when I talk to her, she just tunes me out. I'm struggling with how to get her to help.

dialogue.origin: なるほど…そうなんですね…お仕事、家事と両立されている大変な中で、それは大変ですね…
dialogue.content: I see... I understand... It must be very tough for you, balancing work and housework. That sounds very difficult...

dialogue.origin: 娘さんには、どのようなお手伝いをしてほしいとお考えですか？
dialogue.content: What kinds of things would you like your daughter to help with?

dialogue.origin: 洗濯を入れる、畳む、などで十分です。茶碗もたまにでも洗ってくれたら…と思いますがそこまで言わないのでせめて自分の水筒を洗うくらいはして欲しいです。何度言っても自分の事すらあまりしません。雨の日に使ったカッパなども放り投げっぱなしなど…
dialogue.content: Just bringing in and folding the laundry would be enough. I'd love it if she could even wash the dishes occasionally, but I don't ask for that much. At the very least, I'd like her to wash her own water bottle. No matter how many times I tell her, she hardly even takes care of her own things. She leaves her raincoat thrown on the floor after a rainy day, for example...

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね…せめて負担を減らす意味で自分のことは自分でしてほしいのに、疲れてしまいますよね…
dialogue.content: I see... You'd at least like her to take care of her own things to lessen your burden, and it's exhausting when that doesn't happen.

dialogue.origin: 手伝ってほしいと言うと、聞き流す、とのことでしたが娘さんはどのような様子なのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned that she tunes you out when you ask for help. What is her demeanor like in those moments?

dialogue.origin: 携帯を触りながら流し聞き、都合の悪いことを言われると逃げる、などです。こっちも怒ったりはしていません。たまに本当にしんどい！みたいになってるとしてくれることが本当にごくごく稀にある…程度です。仲もいいし反抗期でもないんですが単純に横着な性格で…どうしたらこちらが何も言わなくても手伝ってくれるのかなと。
dialogue.content: She half-listens while on her phone, and if I say something inconvenient for her, she avoids it. I don't get angry at her. On the very, very rare occasion that I'm visibly at my limit, she might help out a little. We get along well, and it's not a rebellious phase; she's just lazy by nature... I'm wondering how I can get her to help without me having to say anything.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね…稀に手伝いはしてくれるんですね。怒らずに伝えておられるのは、とても良いことだと思いますよ。
dialogue.content: I see... So she does help out on rare occasions. I think it's a very good thing that you're able to communicate with her without getting angry.

dialogue.origin: あなたのことをなんてお呼びしたら、よいでしょうか？ニックネームでもいいので、教えてくださると嬉しいです。
dialogue.content: How would you like me to address you? A nickname is fine—I'd be happy if you could tell me.

dialogue.origin: 【かるた】でお願いします。
dialogue.content: Please call me Karuta.

dialogue.origin: かるたさんですね、お答えいただき、ありがとうございます。娘さんに家事を手伝ってほしいと思うようになったのはいつ頃からですか？
dialogue.content: Karuta, thank you for sharing that. When did you start wanting your daughter to help with the housework?

dialogue.origin: 中学生になってからです。一年前くらいだと思います。週5回、仕事が終わってからの娘の習い事の送迎で往復2時間の運転と待ち時間のストレスなどが増えて体がしんどいと感じるようになりました。
dialogue.content: Since she started junior high school. I think it was about a year ago. Five days a week, after I finish work, I have to drive her to and from her extracurricular activities. The two-hour round-trip drive and the stress of waiting has increased, and I've started to feel physically exhausted.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね…仕事だけでも疲れるのに、その後に往復2時間の送迎なんて本当に大変ですね…かるたさんは娘さんのこと、家事、仕事と本当にたくさんのことを頑張っておられるのが伝わってきます
dialogue.content: I see... Work alone is tiring enough, but a two-hour round trip for pick-up and drop-off on top of that must be exhausting... It's clear that you're working so hard, Karuta, juggling your daughter, housework, and your job.

dialogue.origin: 一年程前から、しんどいと感じるようになられたことは娘さんにはお話はされましたか？
dialogue.content: Have you told your daughter that you've been feeling worn out for the past year or so?

dialogue.origin: 夜の運転は神経を使うから疲れる事、私も歳とってきたからしんどい…等々伝えてはいるんですよねえ…でもひとごとというか。私が倒れないと分からないタイプに感じます。
dialogue.content: I have told her things... that driving at night is nerve-wracking and tiring, and that I'm getting older and it's taking a toll on me... but she treats it like it's someone else's problem. I feel she's the type who won't get it unless I actually collapse.

dialogue.origin: なるほど…そうなのですね…それは悩ましいですね…娘さんがたまにお手伝いしてくれた時は、かるたさんはどのような言葉を掛けたりされていますか？
dialogue.content: I see... I can understand why that would be troubling... When your daughter does help out occasionally, what sort of things do you say to her?

dialogue.origin: ありがとうーーーーー！！と大絶賛です。洗濯を入れてくれてた時なんかは絶対部屋まで行き必ずお礼を言うようにしてました。というかほんとにそれだけでもありがたいので本当にありがとうと言ってました。でも続かないんですよね。挙句、自分は子供も嫌いだし家事なんかしたくないから絶対結婚なんかしない。と言ってました…
dialogue.content: I give her tons of praise, like "Thank yooou so much!!" When she brought in the laundry, for example, I made a point to go to her room and thank her. I'm genuinely grateful for even just that, so I sincerely say thank you. But it never lasts. And to top it all off, she has said, "I don't like kids and I don't want to do housework, so I'm definitely never getting married."

dialogue.origin: それは素晴らしいですね！きちんと褒めてあげることはとても良いことだと思いますよ。そうなんですね…今はまだ中学生ですので、今後、考えも変わるかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: That's wonderful! Praising her properly is a very good thing to do. I see... Well, she is still in junior high, so her perspective might change as she gets older.

dialogue.origin: 続かないのはどうしてだと、かるたさんは思われますか？
dialogue.content: Why do you think it doesn't last, Karuta?

dialogue.origin: 変わればいいのですが小さい時からそういう所が割と冷めた子で…💧なんでなんでしょうね。全然分からないんです。してもらうことが当たり前だと思ってるように感じます。なんで子供の自分がそんな事しないといけないんだ？という感覚のように見えます。
dialogue.content: I hope she'll change, but she's been rather detached about things like this since she was little...💧 I just don't know why. I really don't get it. I feel like she thinks it's natural for things to be done for her. It seems like she feels, "Why should I, a kid, have to do that?"

dialogue.origin: なるほど…それは困ってしまいますね…今までかるたさんが手際よく、家事をこなしておられて娘さんが手伝う隙がなかったようなことは思い当たりますか？
dialogue.content: I see... that would be difficult... Does it ever occur to you that perhaps you've always been so efficient at doing the housework that there was never really an opportunity for your daughter to help?

dialogue.origin: ああ…確かに。やってくれると言っても二度手間になりそうな事はあーしなくていい！とさえぎったり自分が完璧にしないと嫌だったのでさせなかったりしてました…
dialogue.content: Ah... that's certainly true. Even when she offered to help, if I thought it would just create more work for me, I'd stop her and say, "Oh, you don't have to do that!" Also, I wouldn't let her do it because I wanted it to be done perfectly...

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね…もしかすると、そのようなことが重なって、私が手伝うよりお母さんが一人でやった方が楽なんだ！と思ったのかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: I see... It's possible that those experiences piled up, and she might have started to think, "It's easier for Mom to do it alone than for me to help!"

dialogue.origin: おおいにありありですね…
dialogue.content: Very much so—that's definitely a possibility.

dialogue.origin: なるほど…ではここまでお伺いしたことを、少しまとめさせて頂きたいのですが、よろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see... Well, I'd like to take a moment to summarize what we've talked about so far, if that's alright with you.

dialogue.origin: はい、お願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: 家事、仕事、送迎と大変なので、娘さんに協力して欲しい、もしくは自分のことは自分でしてほしい。と、かるたさんは思われている。
dialogue.content: You, Karuta, are finding it difficult to manage housework, your job, and driving your daughter, so you would like her to help out, or at least take care of her own things.

dialogue.origin: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How does that sound?

dialogue.origin: その通りです
dialogue.content: That's exactly right.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。では、娘さんにどのように伝えていくかを一緒に考えるのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. In that case, how about we think together about how to communicate this to your daughter?

dialogue.origin: お願いします！
dialogue.content: Yes, please!

dialogue.origin: 自分ではもうどうやって伝えれば伝わるのか分かりません
dialogue.content: On my own, I no longer know how to say it in a way that will get through to her.

dialogue.origin: ええ…難しいですよね先程、ご自身で気付かれた点、今まで手伝う隙がなく、家事を一人で抱え込んでいたことを娘さんに伝えることがポイントだと思います
dialogue.content: Yes... it's difficult, isn't it? I think a key point would be to tell your daughter what you just realized yourself—that you've been taking on all the housework alone and haven't really given her a chance to help.

dialogue.origin: はい、なるほどです。
dialogue.content: Yes, that makes sense.

dialogue.origin: お母さん今までひとりで家事も完璧にやらないと、って頑張ってきたけど、あなたも中学生になったし、これからは一緒に手伝ってほしいんだ、と素直な気持ちをお伝えしてみるといいかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: It might be a good idea to express your honest feelings to her, something like, "Up until now, I've tried hard to do all the housework perfectly on my own, but you're a junior high school student now, and I'd like you to start helping me from now on."

dialogue.origin: はい。まずそう伝えてみます。
dialogue.content: Okay. I'll try telling her that first.

dialogue.origin: それでイマイチな反応だったらどうしましょう…
dialogue.content: What should I do if her reaction isn't very positive...?

dialogue.origin: そうですね…娘さんはまだ家事（手伝い）をする習慣になっていないだけだと思いますので、あとは小さなことから、手伝ってもらうといいかもしれません
dialogue.content: That's a good point... I think your daughter simply isn't in the habit of doing chores (helping out) yet, so it might be a good idea to have her help with small things to start.

dialogue.origin: 例えば…
dialogue.content: For example...

dialogue.origin: 洗濯などの家事をしないのは、かるたさん自身も困ってしまうと思うので、
dialogue.content: Since not doing chores like laundry would be a problem for you, Karuta,

dialogue.origin: 娘さんの水筒は洗わずにそのまま置いておく、というのはどうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: how about leaving your daughter's water bottle unwashed, as is?

dialogue.origin: 水筒が必要になれば、娘さんが自分で洗って飲み物を入れて持っていくようになるかもしれませんいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: When she needs the water bottle, she might wash it herself, fill it with a drink, and take it with her. What do you think of that idea?

dialogue.origin: 以前やってみたんです…朝まで洗いませんでした…結局私が朝洗いました。1度それでも私が洗わなかった時は持っていきませんでした。洗うくらいならめんどくさいから持っていかんわ。と。重症です。横で言い続けようやく洗った事はあります。自分の習い事に行く時のお茶さえ用意しません…私がやりすぎだったんでしょうか…
dialogue.content: I've tried that before... She didn't wash it, even by the morning... In the end, I washed it. The one time I didn't wash it, she just didn't take it with her. She said, "Washing it is too much of a bother, so I'll just go without it." It's a serious problem. There was a time she finally washed it after I stood next to her and kept telling her to. She won't even get her own drink ready for her lessons... Was I doing too much for her?

dialogue.origin: そんなことがあったんですね…娘さんのことを思ってのことだと思いますので、やりすぎというのは一概に言えないと思いますよ
dialogue.content: So that's what happened... I'm sure you were doing it out of concern for your daughter, so I don't think you can necessarily say you were doing too much.

dialogue.origin: もしかするとそのまま洗わずにいれば、、水筒を洗うかもしれませんし、お茶を自分で買うかもしれませんし、
dialogue.content: It's possible that if you leave it unwashed, she might eventually wash the water bottle, or she might buy her own drink,

dialogue.origin: 自分自身でやらないと、自分が困るということに気付くまで、こちらは何もしないというのを心掛けるといいのかもしれません
dialogue.content: so it might be good to try to do nothing on your end until she realizes that she's the one who will be in trouble if she doesn't do it herself.

dialogue.origin: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What do you think about that?

dialogue.origin: 今思えば過保護だったのかもしれません…そうですね、少し心を鬼にしてやってみた方がいいかもしれませんね、ここまで酷いと。
dialogue.content: Looking back on it now, maybe I was being overprotective... Yes, you're right. Since it's gotten this bad, it might be better if I try to be a little firmer.

dialogue.origin: 提案して頂いた感じでやってみようと思います。ありがとうございます！
dialogue.content: I think I'll try what you've suggested. Thank you!

dialogue.origin: つい言いたくなるお気持ちも当然だと思いますよ娘さん自身がやらなくて本人が困る、責任を取らないといけないようなことは、見守ってあげるといいかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: It's only natural to feel the urge to step in. For things where your daughter herself will face the consequences or have to take responsibility for not doing them, it might be best to just watch and see what happens.

dialogue.origin: もう少しお話したいところですが、そろそろお時間になってしまいました。申し訳ございません。
dialogue.content: I would like to talk more, but it looks like we're almost out of time. I apologize.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですね。言われる事よく分かります。大丈夫です、方向性が見えました！
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right. I understand what you're saying very well. It's okay, I can see a way forward now!

dialogue.origin: それは良かったです本当にしんどい時は手伝ってくれる優しい娘さんなので、家事（手伝い）をする習慣が身に付けば自主的にするようになるかもしれませんので、やってみてくださいね
dialogue.content: I'm glad to hear that. She is a kind daughter who helps you when you're truly struggling, so if she can get into the habit of doing chores, she might start doing them on her own initiative. Please give it a try.

dialogue.origin: また、いつでも相談に来てくださいね
dialogue.content: Please feel free to come back for a consultation anytime.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、習慣として身につけてもらえるように頑張ります。ありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: You're right, I'll do my best to help her make it a habit. Thank you very much!

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、ありがとうございましたでは、相談を終了させて頂きます
dialogue.content: Thank you as well. I will now end our consultation.

dialogue.origin: はい、失礼致します^^
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you. Goodbye. ^^

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました！時間オーバーすみません！勉強になりました！）
dialogue.content: (Thank you very much! Sorry for going over time! This was a great learning experience!)

dialogue.origin: （これで終了致します）
dialogue.content: (This concludes the session.)

dialogue.origin: お時間全然お気になさらないでください！こちらもとても勉強になり、且つ本当に参考になるアドバイスも頂け感謝です。
dialogue.content: Please don't worry about the time at all! This was a great learning experience for me too, and I'm very grateful for the truly helpful advice I received.

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございます＾＾！）
dialogue.content: (Thank you! ^^!)

topic.sub: 娘との家事に関するコミュニケーション問題
